rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something is insufficient in amount, quality, or suitability for a purpose.

example.english: This information is inadequate for making a decision.
example.traditional: 呢份資料唔夠用嚟做決定。
example.jyutping: ne1 fan6 zi1 liu6 m4 gau3 jung6 lai4 zou6 kyut3 ding6

rows.note: Use this when something is judged not up to the required standard, especially someone's work, performance, or ability.

example.english: Your report is inadequate and not good enough to send to the client.
example.traditional: 你份報告做得唔掂，未夠資格交畀客。
example.jyutping: nei5 fan2 bou3 gou3 zou6 dak1 m4 dim6 mei6 gau3 zi1 gaak3 gaau1 bei2 haak3
